source_text: Measure before optimizing; a profiler beats intuition, and premature optimization is the root of much complexity.
pattern: Measure before optimizing; a profiler beats intuition, and premature optimization is the root of much complexity.
reason: Optimize what the profiler names, not what you guess.

source_text: Beware N+1 query patterns and per-item network calls; batch and index at the data layer before tuning code.
pattern: Beware N+1 query patterns and per-item network calls; batch and index at the data layer before tuning code.
reason: The data layer is where most latency actually lives.

source_text: Optimize the hot path only; shaving milliseconds off code that runs once a day is wasted risk.
pattern: Optimize the hot path only; shaving milliseconds off code that runs once a day is wasted risk.

source_text: For web apps, watch bundle size and time-to-interactive; code-split and lazy-load what the first paint does not need.
pattern: For web apps, watch bundle size and time-to-interactive; code-split and lazy-load what the first paint does not need.
reason: First paint is the only performance users feel directly.

source_text: Cache at the right layer and invalidate deliberately; a stale cache is a correctness bug wearing a performance costume.
pattern: Cache at the right layer and invalidate deliberately; a stale cache is a correctness bug wearing a performance costume.
reason: There are two hard problems: naming, cache invalidation, and off-by-one.
